rejected_rule.statement: A threat to do a lawful act may amount to economic duress if the threat is illegitimate and coerces an unwilling seller into acquiescing in a sale.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: This was the duress of circumstances that surrounded the witness on 29.04.1992. This appears to have been the approach taken in Atlas Express Ltd v. Kafco (Importers and Distributors) Ltd.
